regions.full_page: Mary Loves Us - Desires our Love "Great is the concourse of people desiring to see and to hear the Queen of Heaven," wrote the Martyr St. Ignatius to St. John, and St. Denis the Aeropagite was most happy to be presented to her by the same Evangelist. "O "my most amiable Lady!" exclaimed Bl. Alphonsus Rodriguez once in prayer to Mary, - I love thee more than myself; but alas! thou dost not love me as I love thee." "Not so, my Alfonsus," she answered, "I love thee more than it is possible for thee to love me. Nay, my love so far surpasses thine as Heaven is above Earth. "Be astonished 0 ye heavens! at this," she cries out with Jerem; "they have forsaken me, the fountain of living waters and have digged to themselves cisterns broken cisterns that can hold no water." Jerem. (II 12-13) "I am called by all, the Mother of Mercy, and truly the mercy of my son hath made me merciful, and hesis miserable who will not when he can, approach mercy." (Rev. to St. Brigit lib. II).

"Hail shall overturn the hope of falsehood; and waters shall over- flow its protection. And your league with death shall be abolished and your covenant with hell shall not stand. Isaias XXVIII 17. First Mass or Holy Orders "A faithful man shall be much praised". Prov. XXVIII 20 "And he that is the keeper of his Master shall be glorified. Prov. XXVII 18
